channel.title: Max Players: 7 on More Than Games
channel.description: Recent content in Max Players: 7 on More Than Games

item.title: Review: Starfinder Second Edition GM Core (Paizo)
item.description: Fans and players launched into the new world of Starfinder Second Edition (2e) when the Player Core released in early August. 16+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Second Edition Player Core (Paizo)
item.description: On Thursday morning of Gen Con in 2017, Paizo released the Starfinder Roleplaying Game. 16+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder 2nd Edition Playtest Rulebook (Paizo)
item.description: Seven years after its successful launch, the Starfinder Roleplaying Game is headed for a second edition — and Paizo wants everyone to get a voice in its creation. 13+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Interstellar Species (Paizo)
item.description: When Paizo’s Starfinder roleplaying game launched, players could choose among only a handful of species options for their characters. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Galactic Magic (Paizo)
item.description: There’s a rhythm to the expansion books for roleplaying games. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Galaxy Exploration Manual (Paizo)
item.description: The world is a big place to explore, but it’s not much compared to a whole universe. 13+, 4-7 players, 1-4 hours to set up, 4-6 hours to play

item.title: Review: Starfinder Beginner Box Review
item.description: Trying to make a useful “beginner” version of anything takes some guts, especially if the topic at hand is more complex than explaining Dots and Boxes or successfully walking your dog. 13+, 2-7 players, 5-30 to set up, 30-60 minutes to play
